name: discord-reader
description: Read and analyze Discord channels available to a bot account

interface.shortDescription: Read and summarize Discord server history.
interface.longDescription: Discover Discord servers and channels, page through message history, inspect threads, and produce cross-channel summaries using a read-only bot token.
interface.defaultPrompt: Read the Discord channels I can access and summarize the important discussions, decisions, links, and unresolved questions.
